title: Lamb Tagine with German Twist
description: A classic North African lamb tagine with a twist of German flavors, featuring aromatic spices and a charred, smoky taste.

ingredients.name: German Beer
ingredients.notes: Dark beer such as Bock or Schwarzbier

ingredients.name: Charred Lemons
ingredients.notes: Sliced and charred over an open flame

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add onions to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic, chermoula, beer, and aromatic spices to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the lamb with charred lemons and steamed vegetables.
